description: The Houtribsluizen are the 1975 lock complex at Lelystad, two ship locks and a discharge sluice of six openings between seven concrete lift towers. The viewpoint is the public dike. It is overcast, about 14.6°C, with wind near 4.7 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. No ship name is shown. It is not a windmill. The Blocq van Kuffeler pumping station is another scene and is not in this frame.
